description: Curated demo subset of the iteration-5 re-derivation audit: the full adjudicated contradictions ledger (every claim in the iteration-4 draft, with the value the prose published and the value re-derived from disk), plus the reference results the original pipeline produced.
primary_metric: claim_match_rate = MATCH / (MATCH + MISMATCH) under the FROZEN prereg tolerance rule. UNVERIFIABLE and SOURCE_ABSENT are reported separately and are NEVER folded into the denominator.

secondary_rounding_aware.label: POST-HOC SECONDARY. Not the primary metric.
secondary_rounding_aware.rule: a published value quoted to k decimals MATCHES if the re-derived value rounds to it at k decimals (or already satisfies the frozen tolerance)
secondary_rounding_aware.why_reported: Prose quotes values to 2-3 decimals while the frozen tolerances are 5e-4 to 5e-3, so some frozen-rule mismatches are rounding of quoted prose. Reporting both rates separates rounding from substantive error without relaxing the primary rule.

claims_withdrawn.reason: Category error. The published per-band values (0.15/0.19/0.31) are the keyword proxy's reported refusal RATE under arm F, not Cohen's kappa. The per-band kappa values remain in results/table_causal_grid.json as a separate, valid finding.
